facts.fact: The document names Kenya's National Digital Master Plan 2022 - 2032 and states its period as 2022 to 2032; it does not say whether the text is public, and does not describe the plan's scope.

The document says the Master Plan targets 100,000 km of fibre-optic cable, 25,000 public Wi-Fi hotspots and nationwide digital village hubs, with no cost stated; no per-target dates are given beyond the 2022-2032 period.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, with an Inter-Ministerial Steering Committee

note: Class of the Master Plan left empty: the document gives only dated targets and period, not scope. Facts keep the report date 2026-10-01 as the document date; the period is the stated event.
